subject: Ending
text: The screen shows an open book with a picture of Mike standing at the cliff on the left page, and the right page reads: What a wild adventure! If I hadn't lived it, I wouldn't believe it!

evidence.quote:
(The screen shows an open book. On the left page is a picture of Mike standing 
at the cliff.)
Right page: What a wild adventure! If I hadn't lived it, I wouldn't believe it!
